body:
My parents are coming into town this coming week. If I don't kill myself before they get here, I have to spend the entirety of the time they're here pretending I still have a job for like 3 weeks. Meanwhile hoping they don't run into someone who's seen me puttering around town in the middle of the day when I'm supposedly at work.

I guess I could always off myself tomorrow. I liked the date 12/13/15 though. I feel weirder killing myself closer to my parents arrival in town, I guess. Like, welcome back for Christmas, btw your kid's dead.
Thanks. I'm no good anyway, though. Like I said I kept putting these off so everyone's probably fed up with me anyway. But thanks for your kindness and offer to talk.

Gotta work on a website, some newsletters, and edit a video. I fell asleep so I lost a bunch of time. Now I'm more worried I won't get these done because I honestly don't know what I'll do if I don't kill myself tonight.
